description: Acknowledging the quiet feminist coup d'etat... the pernicious misandry... the militant and divisive zero-sum/win-lose assumptions of the ruling feminist movement... unfair treatment of males as disposable...the apparently shocking notion that women are capable of violence. Barbara Kay presents her politically incorrect views on the Micheal Coren Show.

chapters.title: Women Are More Violent to Children than Men Are
